newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuba celebrates defense day with mobilization.
newsitem.headline: Cuba celebrates defense day with mobilization.

text.p: Air raid sirens sounded and hundreds of thousand of civilian militia members were mobilised thoughout Cuba on Sunday to celebrate the Day of Defence.

Students, professionals, office workers, store employees, farmers and industrial workers who belong to the volunteer "Territorial Militia Troops" gathered in platoons and companies to drill, shoot at targets with automatic rifles, and receive classes in the adequate tactics for defending their local areas.

Cuba's Territorial Militia has the task of supporting the island's regular army in the event of an enemy invasion and of carrying on a prolonged guerrilla struggle if the island is occupied by foreign trooops.
Some of the military exercises were aimed a protecting apartment buildings, schools, factories and other "socio- economic objectives" in the event of war.

At schools, students and teachers practiced throwing metal stars with sharp points and the use of other homemade weapons and traps similar to those used by the Viet Cong against American troops during the Vietnam War.

At the oceanside town of Caiminera in southeastern Cuba across from the U.S Naval Base at Guantanamo, a special militia naval detachment of small boats held training exercises to improve its capacity to patrol the Cuban coast.
